Dana White said women would NEVER fight in the UFC. Then he met her. 👀 The first time White ever met Ronda Rousey, she grabbed him at a weigh-in and asked for ten minutes. They talked for twenty. Ten minutes in, White knew - this was the one. He walked out and called Lorenzo Fertitta on the spot: he was doing the women’s division, and Ronda was the one to build it with. Then he made her the headliner of an entire pay-per-view, above a stacked Dan Henderson vs. Lyoto Machida co-main. The backlash was brutal.
